_comment: Gemma-4-26B-A4B variant of the primary config: chat model served by the combined gemma+nomic llama-server on 8081 (docker-compose.gemma26b-embed.yml). output_dir separates ALL kg.run progress/datasets into outputs/gemma26b so the qwen artifacts stay untouched; graph/embedding/repo caches are chat-model-free and stay shared. max_context_tokens lowered 128000->120000: token estimates are not gemma-tokenizer-aware and the served context is 131072, so this keeps a safe margin against tokenizer drift.
_comment_max_tokens: Exploration budget raised 1024->3072 for gemma thinking-ON mode: reasoning chains measured up to ~880 tokens before the tool-call JSON, so 1024 risks truncation-with-empty-content. Thinking must stay ON for exploration: with enable_thinking=false gemma emits its native <|tool_call> wrappers and string-form function keys that extract_function_calls cannot parse (0 calls, instant stop — verified 2026-09-11).
